reason: I already pay for Fresha and I will not switch my calendar for a chatbot. A bot that guesses at my prices or treatments and books the wrong thing puts my reputation at risk, and I would have to clean up after it.
objection: What if the AI gives a patient or customer wrong information about prices, treatments or availability and I only find out after they turn up?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run on my own site with real questions, showing it hands over to my staff instead of guessing, and proof it works alongside Fresha without double bookings.
